title: Overdrive live coach: the end of a session
description: The optional body of POST /v1/live/sessions/{id}/end (spec §12.1, ADR 0038): the app says the ride is over. reason is finished (the workout ran to its end), stopped (the rider ended the ride) or error (the app gave up); clock is the app's clock in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Both are optional and the body may be left out altogether (no body, or {}). The service answers live-session-end-response.schema.json: 200 also when the session had already ended.
